title: M7.P5: Replace automatic cloud migration with explicit folder setup
body:
## Current qualification — source-overlay UI complete

Published [final evidence and handoff](https://github.com/pixelelated/distribution/blob/d5e2f78618624cad919afaba6784bef3f7eaf8c7/docs/qa-logs/2026-10-07-cloud-validator/ui/README.md) at distribution next `d5e2f78618624cad919afaba6784bef3f7eaf8c7`; remote readback verified. Product source remains clean and local/unintegrated: distribution `6f89bc7cecee5972909828103689e2c7c0711c30`, ES `4e410dc9a816cc947f16235ad2b24824b29dd84e`. #512 localized failure/check-busy wording, #513 small-panel help/editor fit and #514 selected-folder empty guidance are fixed and qualified in that ES source. Their inclusion is explicitly tracked here under #508; no pin or installed device changed.

The final UI index has **99 entries: 89 reviewed screenshots, nine rejected screenshots retained, and CF10 final firmware/public adoption pending**. It includes positive scan-to-supported-systems/back, empty-selected/populated-other-library refusal, all changed help variants, interrupted/failed/retried checks, selective folder creation, OAuth UI and restore-finish callbacks. Exact source/catalog identities and explicit unchanged-input reuse are retained. Root verified the full inventory before retiring the guest/compiler, independently confirmed resource absence and all worker seals, and retained 529 final sealed files. Cleanup reclaimed4.86GiB. No build, VM or audit job remains active in this lane.

Full host regression remains **1,311 top-level PASS**, zeroFAIL/SKIP; ordinary VM WebDAV/SFTP each **108 PASS**. #512 unit logic passes183cases/4752assertions; later text-only fixes have separate compile/link/syntax/catalog/vocabulary proof. Existing accepted candidate16/device firmware and the78-frame baseline remain unchanged. The required D-WORKFLOW-155/156 flow-and-reviewed-screenshot process is published in both agent entrypoints, the canonical UI rule and the evidence-index schema. A mechanical title/index check is not semantic screenshot coverage.

**Remaining order:** #510's unanswered release-scope choice for small-file repair → #508 qualified source/pin integration → #507 frozen independent post-candidate16 audit → assembled firmware/public ROCKNIX and clean-install qualification, source/licence and named physical gates. The validator direction is settled; generic save-file organization is not implemented and must not be silently claimed. No new external audit, device build or personal-cloud action has occurred.

## Active implementation — release lane resumed

> Sounds good, and we should trigger a new lane if you want, within Herdr, for website work. I want to keep us focused here in this lane on the critical path of getting the build completed. We were in the flow, trying to get everything done. Run the changes and adjustments for the release candidate to simplify the experience and expectations of what happens when connecting a new remote via rclone, and I don't want to lose that progress and momentum.

Historical checkpoint at 2026-10-08 02:31 UTC (superseded by the final proof above): distribution6f89bc7cecee5972909828103689e2c7c0711c30 and ESbaeea2a8c9bf508949104abcf04583a2338e054f remain local/unintegrated. Restore boundary controls pass21/21, validator controls30/30, ES182 cases/4727 assertions and changed-source linking. The final full host run20261008T021032Z-6981bf69 completed at02:18:59UTC: 1,311 top-level PASS, zeroFAIL/zeroSKIP, actual build/wrapper/launcher channels0; direct invocation has no inner.rc. Ordinary VM WebDAV and SFTP round trips each pass108 checks and all four completion channels. Earlier failed/withdrawn controls remain traceable in docs/qa-logs/2026-10-07-cloud-validator/.

Main UI proof has39 reviewed frames and two rejected frames. Independent review found additional help/error/diagnostic variants: supplemental indexed entries are being exercised by rc_cloud_ui on one new disposable source-overlay VM. The complete diff-derived inventory also covers changed scan/transfer continuation and connection callbacks. #512 records missing localization coverage for three introduced reasons plus an actual busy-check screen incorrectly labelled as synchronization; the narrow fix and affected French proof are in progress. The original guest and completed compiler scratch were retired with compact receipts. Review the complete affected copy/branch inventory before retiring the supplemental guest. The nested-folder warning is ordinary script stdout; consumer tracing must distinguish it from the actual displayed transfer result. Accepted firmware and its visual baseline remain unchanged.

Can this be done on the VM? Yes: supplemental saves/settings/game-content help, rejected/unreadable path changes and nested-folder transfer outcomes use unchanged source plus synthetic WebDAV on GENERIC_X64. No physical-device or personal-cloud action is needed. Do not repeat the passing broad/ordinary VM suites without a new source change or concern.

D-WORKFLOW-156 now requires source, canonical flow/IA reference and reviewed indexed screenshots before UI completion or pin promotion, including text-only changes and each distinct affected content variant. Generic small-file organization remains an explicitly unresolved contract item; the maintainer’s scope question is pending. Next: close supplemental visual coverage, resolve that scope item, then integrate qualified source and proceed to #507. No product pin change or new device build has occurred.

Website #511 has its own Herdr lane, waiting for the named startup trust confirmation. This firmware lane remains on the ordered M7 critical path.

Can this be done on the VM? Yes: source parser/transport controls use isolated synthetic host fixtures; controller flows, EN/FR640×480 and1280×800 frames use one disposable GENERIC_X64 guest. Qualified image adoption is still separate. No personal cloud or physical-device action is needed.

## Maintainer requests

> yes, please do. if we're moving this many files, we should make sure the user knows that they can resume the migration and that no files have been lost and that the integrity of the transfer will be double-checked once it is complete.

Then the maintainer reconsidered moving whole libraries:

> also, we should consider if this is an ineffective process for large libraries. for example, some of my roms are gigabytes big. also, not everyone will have synced everything for that device, so we might wind up confusing users. would a rename be simpler? also, no one has used my fork yet except me, so I'm really the only person migrating. if this is the case, maybe we can take a simpler route? for example, maybe we should just let the user go through the standard new rclone backend link flow to create the `/pixelelated` directory and stub directories, and then they handle the migration?

> I'm fine doing a rename on my end, and then we can abandon the migration entirely, or at least I think we can. I don't think we have an existing cloud migration path for ROCKNIX users that were going to switch to our newer cloud backend configuration, did we? I thought we were just creating the directory structure and then letting them populate it.

> if that's the case, we could access Dropbox directly from this machine and clean everything up in Dropbox without having to go through the handheld.

## Verified history and present behavior

The submitted September 29 distribution PR ROCKNIX/distribution#3404 already included an optional cloud_migrate_layout cleanup from /GAMES to /ROCKNIX. ES PR ROCKNIX/emulationstation-next#40 exposed TIDY UP YOUR CLOUD FOLDERS with preview and MOVE / LEAVE THEM. Both were closed without merging. Normal linking also seeded folders and README files. Startup migration prompts, automatic join/follow and renamed destinations came later. This correction was given to the maintainer; removal is a new product simplification, not a claim migration never existed.

Current migration recursively processes the eligible remote content tree, independent of games present on the device. Copy may be server-side where supported; hashless-backend verification downloads both copies. Setup currently calls --settle, scans call --join/--follow, and ES may silently adopt discovered content, so removing one dialog alone would not establish manual setup.

## Intended replacement and boundaries

Use ordinary backend linking and explicit folder selection. Fresh configurations default to /pixelelated/Saves, /pixelelated/Backups and /pixelelated/Content, with the existing folders and README seeding. Keep existing credentials and configured paths until the player selects another folder. No automatic legacy-folder joining/following, whole-library move or migration prompt. Retain ordinary save sync, selective content backup/restore, settings backup/restore, and relevant unreadable/missing/future-layout guards. Manual cloud rearrangement is separate from linking and does not reset local library choices.

#505's exact approved patch was applied only in an isolated feature tree and has not been integrated or VM-tested. Further migration-specific diagnostics/copy work is held by this replacement. Existing accepted firmware remains frozen; new source needs focused proof and later firmware inclusion. #507 audits the settled resulting P5 delta.

Can this be done on the VM? Yes: synthetic WebDAV/SFTP/local S3 fixtures and candidate16 overlay prove setup, pointer preservation, selective restore and UI behavior. No personal-cloud mutation is part of those tests. Owner Dropbox recovery begins with host-side read-only inventory if authenticated access exists; private inventories remain local and any move/delete plan requires exact separate authorization.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Source/install and ES call-site sweep proves there is no installed automatic migration engine, legacy autojoin/follow, startup migration prompt or TIDY move action; syntax/package/catalog checks pass.
- [ ] Synthetic clean linking creates nothing; a separately confirmed selected-category CREATE FOLDERS action creates the chosen /pixelelated folders/READMEs without modifying an existing /ROCKNIX tree. Retained before/after hashes and pointer receipts prove both boundaries.
- [ ] Current public ROCKNIX configurations (/GAMES with nested /GAMES/backup, including explicit custom paths) retain credentials, pointers and cloud bytes through adoption, scans and setup unless explicit selection changes a pointer. Clean installs are proven separately; unpublished experimental states remain historical regressions, not added public compatibility requirements.
- [ ] Validation/restore discovery stays within explicitly selected roots; configured library choices survive unrelated folder changes. VM path/config receipts prove there is no silent fallback or adoption outside that scope.
- [ ] Ordinary save/settings/content flows, missing/unreadable/future-layout handling and partial-device-library restore remain functional on focused synthetic fixtures; no whole-cloud transfer is triggered by linking or scanning.
- [ ] English/French source and actual 640x480/1280x800 VM frames show the simplified flow and truthful manual-setup guidance. Menu map, adoption docs, decisions and M7 order match the implementation.
- [ ] New pins/package installation and final artifact inclusion are explicitly mapped; no source-overlay result is claimed as installed release firmware.

Host Dropbox inventory/reconciliation remains separately scoped and private; no rename or deletion has been performed.

## Owner refinement: selected folders and ROM libraries

> Also, with the "tidy up your cloud folders," that only mattered once they'd linked a cloud backend. We should respect their choice in doing that. If they happen to choose a different folder, I didn't think we would move their ROMs around. If we need to add more clarity to our own flows and what tidying up is, we should think more about that. Moving around ROMs, as we found, can be a very data-intensive operation, and so we might want to delineate between organizing or moving ROMs versus all of the other files we deal with. We're not finding ourselves in a situation where we're trying to use a handheld with a limited CPU to move hundreds of GB of files.


For this RC, keep the approved manual setup replacement. Linking or changing the selected folder never relocates a ROM library. The subsequent pre-build review in #510 now settles library choices and any progress-only organization before this draft is integrated. Naming follow-up is #509.

## Pre-build review hold — D-CLOUD-177

#510 is now the first dependency. Finish and retain current synthetic checks, but do not integrate this product draft or generate device firmware until the D-CLOUD-178 validator contract is reconciled and qualified. Existing experimental-state fixtures are historical regressions, not requirements for users adopting public ROCKNIX. Reconcile actual release20261001 /GAMES and nested /GAMES/backup preservation, independent ROM selection, out-of-root restore fallbacks and the obsolete TIDY warning with the resulting decision. The 1303-check broad PASS and focused81-check setup correction qualify specific draft bytes, not the unapproved flow. No cloud credentials or files have been touched.

## Validator refinement — D-CLOUD-178, #510

The owner chose category validation with separate explicit smaller-file fixes. Extend this replacement with bounded read-only findings, enabled-category seeding and manual ROM/BIOS guidance. Do not run backup/restore as a validation shortcut. Reuse existing classification/UI primitives after separating their side effects. #510 holds the concrete operation/consent contract; #511 defines the separate GitHub Pages/site and future ROM/BIOS QR guides. Local instructions do not wait for the site.

Additional qualification criteria:

- [ ] Structured category results distinguish present, missing, empty, recognized misplaced and unreadable; exact selected-root/config/run identity rejects stale cache results. Synthetic provider failures cannot appear as missing content or successful readiness.
- [ ] Opening checks or instructions changes no credentials, selected paths or remote files; selected-category creation is explicit and leaves disabled tiers and unrelated files untouched, with before/after receipts.
- [ ] Each supported progress-file fix has a preview and separate confirmation; failing controls prove collision preservation, stale-plan refusal, bounded size/transport, interruption safety and no ROM/BIOS/unknown-file movement. Unsupported cases get honest instructions rather than a blanket tidy action.
- [ ] ROM and BIOS findings offer See instructions with expected paths and useful local guidance; no speculative/dead QR destination or handheld-browser expectation. #511 owns later published guide QR activation and its tests.

Retained draft evidence: distribution3268015c, ES300f97d2; broad1303 PASS on the pre-edge source, focused81 and VM edge checks on final cloud_setup a7eea387, and UI packet with explicit EN1280 intro truncation. These are source/overlay checks, not finished validator or firmware proof. All QA guests/endpoints/scratch belonging to that earlier draft were retired. The new validator proof has its own active guest and watched host run identified above; no device build is active.
